content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Ghana, traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either inaccessible or restrictive, forcing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators to find alternative solutions. COREMERCH offers a robust infrastructure for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]]-store-cloudflare-pages-everything-you-need-16|building]] a crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring you maintain sovereignty over your digital products and payment processes. This guide will walk you through the necessary steps to deploy your store quickly and effectively, allowing you to focus on creating instead of worrying about payment issues.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When conventional payment platforms fail, creators are left without viable options for monetizing their digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to empower creators by leveraging decentralized payment methods and cloud-based hosting solutions. By using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you eliminate dependency on traditional banking systems, ensuring that you can sell your ebooks, courses, and digital goods without interruptions. This architecture not only provides reliability but also ownership of your data and transactions, allowing you to operate freely in a global market.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, gather the necessary tools and accounts. You'll need a Cloudflare account to set up your pages and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with GitHub for version control and hosting your site, and consider using Supabase for order management. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, as well as branding materials like logos and product images. This preparation will streamline your deployment process and set you up for success in launching your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment pipeline using NOWPayments. Create your product listings and integrate them into your Cloudflare Pages setup. Utilize Google Apps Script to automate order processing and delivery of digital products. This integration allows for seamless transactions, where payments trigger automatic delivery of files to customers. Ensure you test the entire workflow thoroughly before going live to identify any potential issues. This step is crucial for providing a smooth customer experience and building trust in your new store.
Deploy quickly and efficiently with COREMERCH's streamlined infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Announce your launch on social media and relevant platforms to attract your first customers. Monitor your payment processing through NOWPayments to ensure transactions are confirmed and products are delivered without any hiccups. Utilize feedback from your early users to refine your store's functionality and customer service. This initial phase is vital for establishing your online presence and gaining momentum in the digital marketplace.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and operating smoothly, consider strategies for scaling your offerings. Use the Edge Commerce Stack to expand your store’s capabilities, allowing for more products and improved backend management. Engage with your audience to understand their needs and adjust your offerings accordingly. Leverage data analytics to refine marketing strategies and enhance customer experiences. With the right tools in place, your store can grow sustainably without the constraints of traditional payment systems.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Maintain full ownership of your data and transactions without platform dependency.

If you're exploring options for hosting a digital product store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This robust solution, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, can be deployed in just 48 hours, making it an excellent choice for creators looking to establish their online presence. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

To build a store that accepts crypto payments for free, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transaction processing. This combination enables you to create a fully functional digital store without the fees associated with traditional payment platforms.

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for a simpler setup but may take 4-6 hours to deploy. Stack 02 incorporates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, is more robust, and is deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing included.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide the necessary infrastructure for deploying your store and handling payments through crypto solutions like NOWPayments.
